comments.author: Meng Meng
comments.body:
1: Talk to Duke Farnese in seville (Have r14 Evasion)
2: Talk to town official in madiera (Have r14 Evasion)
3: Kill capture fleet south of madeira.
4: Kill capture fleet that is south west of las palmas (long ways SW).
5: Kill capture fleet that is north (and a little to the east near the small island) of santiago.

comments.author: Carla
comments.body:
Most job quests are. A few exceptions are those in a chain (like having a pre-quest); that said, they replace the initial unrepeatable job card quests with repeatable job card quests.

Now, I haven't taken this particular quest myself, but I'd expect it to be repeatable, especially given how expensive the job is to change into without a card.
